//: Deliberately poor copies, following the bundled mod's civilian_cop_glock22 pattern. Dispersion is inflated far past the real weapon so bikers miss often, and durability is low so a looted one is a stopgap rather than a prize.
description: A battered handgun carried by biker bandits.  The barrel has seen better decades.
A single-barrel shotgun cut down past all good sense.  Loud, short-ranged and unkind to the shoulder.

//: pipe_rifle is copy-from rifle_home_made and chambers .22 - about as weak as firearms get, which is the point.  Dispersion inflated further on top.
description: A length of pipe, a crude stock and a firing pin.  It throws a .22 round in roughly the intended direction.

//: Mirrors the Civilians mod's civilian_cop_glock22 (copy-from glock_22, dispersion 2400, durability 5) without referencing it - section 2.1 forbids depending on any id that mod owns, so the equivalent is rebuilt here.
description: A police sidearm, carried by an officer still trying to do the job.  Deliberately less accurate than the real thing.
